title: Thornbak
extract:
Thornbak is a burst-fire rifle. It fires four rounds in quick succession, boasting incredible Status Chance.

Characteristics
This weapon deals equal physical damage.
Advantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
High reload speed (1.80 s)
High ammo max (540)
High fire rate (6.00 attacks/sec)
Very high status chance (36.00%)
Disadvantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (6.00%)
Very low burst DPS (144.80)
Very low sustained DPS (123.25)
Very low damage per shot (114.68)
Very low total damage (28)
Low accuracy (0.00° to 8.00°)
Very low disposition (●●●○○ (1.10x))
Very low crit multiplier (1.40x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Thornbak is awarded during The Teacher quest, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. Additional copies can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for  100,000.

Notes

Trivia
 Thornbak shares a similar look to the Kyndryn Gunblade Skin.
